reason: NONE at $29.99. The first thing I noticed was 'Every batch lab-tested' with the QR and the price per box, and a dollar a day is more than I spend on vitamins. I'd wait for a flash sale or coupon, and I'd only take a chance on the one-sachet-a-day box.
objection: Two capsules a day, and size 00 capsules are big. I already forget my vitamins half the time, so I'm scared of paying $30 for a box I'll leave on the counter.
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon bringing the box to about $19 to $20, or a smaller trial box so I can check the capsules are easy to swallow.
